note: Cold start (docs/results/cold-start-2026-09-24.md). Offline: flows learned by `stretto learn --results` from GLM-5's own sessions (trial 0 of each training task drawn), replayed on GLM-5's test episodes, all four trials, lookup first at 0.3. Runs are keyed domain/sessions/sample/flow. Samples: draw 1 and random = --train-fraction (the mixed order); draws 2-4 = --train-tasks 10,20,22,47,112; 8,13,14,28,75; 21,44,76,93,107; clustered = the old sampler's order (retail 5: 104-107,109; retail 10: 98,103-107,109,110,112,113; airline 5: 40-43,49); all = every training task. Flows: arbiter flow = 70/30; habit alone = --habit-only; refitted = --refit-habit; other agents' arbiter = --arbiter-from the all-task compile of four 2025 agents. Episode rows: [episode, turns, turns saved, flow lookups, detours]. Comparisons: B minus A in turns saved, paired by episode, bootstrapped over tasks (4,000 draws). Live: the flow learned from five sessions GLM-5.3 recorded (tasks 15, 24, 76, 88, 99), its offline check on GLM-5's 40 trial-0 test episodes, and its live episodes paired with the retail pilots' arms.

pilot.note: Retail, GLM-5.3 in Claude Code, the retail pilot's ten test tasks. cold is the flow learned by stretto learn from five sessions GLM-5.3 ran on training tasks 15, 24, 76, 88 and 99 through the proxy, with the conversation handed to it (three train the habit, two hold out the 15 decisions its arbiter is fitted on). baseline and flows (D0) are the 2026-09-24 retail pilot's episodes, habit the habit-only pilot's.
